label: Cloud vs. local
question: Should we host an open model or use a managed LLM API?
context: A small internal support tool serves 50 employees. Usage is uncertain and no dedicated ML operations team exists. Assume $2,400/month for a dedicated GPU host and $600/month for the API at expected usage. Sensitive data must be redacted before any external request.

strategist.rationale: Fifty users and uncertain demand make utilization the central unknown. Launch the smallest useful pilot before reserving infrastructure.
assumptions: External processing is permitted after redaction.

engineer.rationale: Instrument request volume and quality while keeping prompts portable. Under the supplied estimates, annual API spending is $7,200 versus $28,800 for hosting.
assumptions: The API estimate includes expected prompt and response volume.
risks: Redaction can remove context needed for useful answers.

skeptic.rationale: A low API bill does not justify sending restricted information outside the organization. Test redaction and access rules before enabling the pilot.
assumptions: The organization has a documented external-processing policy.
risks: Redaction may miss identifiers or secrets.

strategist.challenge: Dedicated hosting assumes demand that has not been observed.
strategist.concession: The data-policy constraint can outweigh the cost advantage.
strategist.revised_position: Pilot a managed API only for approved, sanitized requests.

engineer.challenge: Hybrid routing adds two failure paths to a small application.
engineer.concession: Some sensitive tasks may require local execution.
engineer.revised_position: Start with one provider adapter and record tasks that cannot use it.

skeptic.challenge: A privacy claim requires tests rather than a provider label.
skeptic.revised_position: Require redaction tests and a documented permitted-data policy before launch.

memo.title: Start managed. Measure the workload.
memo.recommendation: Use a managed API with redaction and a portable model gateway.
memo.summary: At the supplied usage estimate, dedicated hosting adds cost and operating work before demand is established. A managed API supports the pilot while quality tests and usage telemetry reveal whether local hosting is justified.
agreement: Measure quality and usage during a limited pilot.
Keep prompts and provider integration portable.
disagreements: Which tasks can legally and operationally use external processing?
At what utilization would dedicated hosting become worthwhile?
next_steps: Define permitted data and test the redaction layer.
Pilot with a small opt-in team and a spending limit.
Compare task quality and cost using a representative evaluation set.
memo.revisit_when: Revisit when observed usage changes the cost comparison or data restrictions exclude a managed provider.
